About me

I’m a fashion stylist with hands-on experience in mannequin styling for Arrow and Flying Machine at Arvind Fashion Week.

My interests include contemporary menswear, streetwear, silhouette exploration, colour coordination and visual storytelling.

I build cohesive looks that communicate a clear aesthetic and reflect brand identity. With an eye for detail, I bring fresh ideas and thoughtful styling to editorial, commercial and brand-focused projects.
